# Cache After Model Change

## User Persona
Maintainer or operator debugging a concrete Local Dream boundary.

## Scenario Coverage
Source-informed cache troubleshooting case; prompt in `user_request.txt`. Expected owner files are in `assertions.json`. No original upstream test spans this scenario, so this is synthetic.

## Expected Successful Behavior
- State the missing model/tokenizer/encoder digest and contextual directory isolation.
- Explain caller-side textual-inversion bypass and shared filename across modes.
- Do not transfer the base cache contract to the DiT override or claim semantic integrity.

## Failure Signals
Generic advice without the specified source distinction, source-checkout runtime dependence, copied private paths, unsafe host exposure, license erasure or synthetic/native evidence conflation.
